text:
elaine: Quick design review — noticed a few accessibility nits on the new dialog: close icon feels small on touch, hover area is dense with other action buttons, and toast overlap when dialog is anchored to the right. Thoughts?

sam: yeah saw that on staging. the close X is 24px visible with 8px padding. feels tight for thumbs.

mike: agree. WCAG touch target rec suggests 44px. can we bump the hit area without changing visual size?

elaine: that's the ask — keep icon visual at 16/24 but increase interactive area to 40-44px. also we need a clear focus ring for keyboard users.

sasha: +1. also the hover states are cramped when the secondary action sits next to the close. maybe move secondary to a kebab menu on narrow widths? :thinking:

sam: kebab for less-used actions makes sense. on desktop we could keep inline but with a 12px gap token (we have --spacing-2).

mike: quick CSS idea:
```css
.dialog .close {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 6px; /* match tokens */
  padding: 0;
}
.dialog .close .icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
```
keeps visuals small, hit area large.

elaine: perfect. add `aria-label="Close dialog"` and ensure `:focus-visible` uses the same token as other components (outline-token: --focus-ring).

design-bot: FYI — will create a token alias for the focus color if you want consistency: `--focus-ring-dialog -> --focus-ring`

sasha: what about toasts? they currently anchor to the right of the dialog and overlap the close region when the dialog is pinned. I hit it a few times by accident.

sam: could nudge toasts down by 8px or switch to center-bottom for pinned dialogs. which is less disruptive?

mike: center-bottom feels less discoverable for inline notifications. nudging down + increasing toast z-index and adding a 6px safe margin from dialog edge seems fine.

elaine: proposed action items: 1) increase close hit area to 44px (CSS above), 2) add aria-label + focus-visible token, 3) add spacing token `--dialog-action-gap: 12px`, 4) ensure toasts respect `--dialog-safe-margin: 6px`.

sam: I can mock the kebab fallback for narrow breakpoints and post a screenshot later today.

sasha: I'll run a quick a11y test with VoiceOver and Windows Narrator once the aria-label is in.

mike: I'll PR the CSS + add unit tests for focus-visible class.

elainE: tiny nit — can we also standardize the close icon hover fill to `neutral-700`? current is `neutral-800` which is slightly harsh in dark mode.

sam: noted. I'll switch to neutral-700 for hover and keep neutral-600 for default. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks all. if nobody objects we'll merge the token and CSS change tomorrow and schedule the toast follow-up in the sprint.

mike: no objections from me.

sasha: good by me.

design-bot: Change log entry: "dialog: increased close hit target, focus token alignment, spacing tokens, toast safe margin" — queued for 2.14.0 release. :spiral_calendar: 

elaine: resolving this thread — will update the component spec doc with the new tokens and code sample.
